title: Sandy Visions: look beyond optimizing metrics, obsess over customer happiness, and explore the bigger opportunity
summary: A reflective essay on the magic of landing the first customer and how founders become hooked on growth metrics. Cohen argues that obsessing over customer and employee happiness is the right path to financial results, but metric optimization can blind founders to bigger, truly innovative opportunities beyond the incremental.

principles.text: Obsess over customer and employee happiness at least as much as financial ratios; they are the most efficient path to the financials.
principles.quote: We're not wrong to obsess, so long as we obsess over customer happiness and employee happiness at least as much as self-serving financial ratios, trusting--as I do--that the formers are the most efficient and personally fulfilling path to the latter.

principles.text: Founders are hooked on the thrill of the sale, and that drive escalates into chasing ever larger metrics like MoM growth and scale.
principles.quote: Then single hits aren't enough and you need "biggest ever" to feel the rush, and we become slaves to the mantra of %MoM growth

principles.text: Metrics optimization is necessary but incomplete; the biggest opportunity lies beyond incremental improvement.
principles.quote: our visions must lift beyond the incremental metric and the hourly order rate. Those are necessary and just, but incomplete.

principles.text: A purely metrics-driven compass can't point toward true innovation; you can't see a new dimension if you only measure two.
principles.quote: Where is the space for true innovation and exploration in a land of metrics optimization?  How do you realize you can move vertically when your compass measures only two dimensions?

principles.text: Don't get stuck fighting competitors over a scrap when a vast unexplored ocean lies beyond; step back and explore.
principles.quote: Tomorrow I'll return to the office, fighting the other crabs for seaweed, the wider beach forgotten, oblivious to the vast ocean beyond the surf

principles.text: Each customer acquisition is the product of countless improbable events, so treat every sale as something remarkable.
principles.quote: Each event improbable, yet collectively inevitable.
